deck: 192 PRACTITIONERS STRESS-TEST DEEDS, LEASES, DECIMALS AND EVERY OFFER PER NET ROYALTY ACRE
THEY BUILD TRACT INVENTORIES, TITLE CHAINS, DECLINE-CURVE VALUATIONS AND LEGACIES FOR HEIRS
site_ui.lead: Learn what you actually own beneath the surface, how to prove it on a separate mineral chain of title, and how to reconcile your decimal and price every offer the way working landmen, buyers and royalty owners do.
site_ui.summary: All 12 chapters synthesize 192 verbatim YouTube practitioner testimonies, from mineral estates and leases to division orders, title, shale drilling, valuation, taxes, regulators and market news. Every claim, metric, pro-tip and quote carries timestamped inline attribution to the practitioner and video it came from.
chapters: What You Actually Own: Mineral Estates, Royalties and Their Carve-Outs
Locating, Researching and Inventorying Your Minerals
The Oil and Gas Lease, Pooling and Owner Bargaining Power
Working the Numbers: WI and NRI Calculations
Division Orders and the Decimal Interest on Your Check
Landmen and Title: From Courthouse to Curative
How Wells Get Drilled: Horizontal Technology and the Major Shale Plays
Decline Curves, Well Performance and Mineral Valuation
Taxes, Working Interests and Passing Minerals to Heirs
Mineral Market News, Capital and Emerging Opportunities
flow: Pull the legal description from the source deed, plot it on a free state GIS, and log every tract in one spreadsheet with interest type, net acres, lease status and provenance.
Run a dedicated mineral title search on its separate chain from the surface, hiring a landman at about $600 a day or a limited search at about $3,000 when needed.
Before trusting an alert or a nearby pad, pull the permit and plat and confirm the first take point and lateral footage fall inside your tract.
Negotiate before signing, confirm which rights the document affects and who the contact represents, and favor the highest royalty rate over the bonus.
Check that every owner's decimal sums back to the lease royalty, pull the deeds when it misses, and ask the payer which records support its division order.

Convert every offer to dollars per net royalty acre, ask which royalty rate the buyer assumed, and price to remaining economic life after reviewing declines, reserves, operators, rights and lease terms.

tagline: Big Money. Small Teams. No Bullshit.
title: MINERAL RIGHTS
subtitle: Rebuild every decimal before you sign, convert every offer to net royalty acres, trade bonus for royalty, cure title before it costs you, and follow the drill bit from permit to payout.
